reports.title: Textron Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full Year Adjusted EPS and Cash Flow Outlook

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Textron raised its expectation for full-year 2026 GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations to be in the range of $5.64 to $5.74, up from our previous outlook of $5.39 to $5.59. Textron also raised its expectation for full-year 2026 adjusted earnings per share from continuing operations, which is reconciled to GAAP in an attachment to this release, to be in the range of $6.55 to $6.65, up from our previous range of $6.40 to $6.60. Textron also raised its expectation for manufacturing cash flow before pension contributions, a non-GAAP measure, to be in the range of $800 million to $900 million, up from $700 million to $800 million.

Our updated outlook reflects the U.S. Army's receipt of Congressional approval for the ATR request related to the MV-75 Cheyenne program and the associated contract modifications obligating such funding.
